items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...who was it? Papa Subtame by himself? Papa Subtame and Paul Vaughn. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh.

ctx.x: One of my friends over here heard that they wanted a pianist. And he recommended me. And they came over and interviewed me. And that's where it started.
What did, what, when you say that, who was it? Papa Subtame by himself? Papa Subtame and Paul Vaughn.
